_about: Neon Harbour as a plan (Claude I, lane I, 21 Oct), in Claude F's region-plan schema (#174). From the brief docs/vision/regions/neon-harbour-delta.md and world plan 8.5 (v5.3); routes are lane G's lines, widths and tiers (lib/world-routes.ts, #175). World px; tier outlines in screen space; local tier 0 = world 1 (the strand). The ria, the falls and the coast are derived from the brief and G's crossings (the Harbour Bridge's 480 px span sets the ria's width at y 4984, the old bridges' 200 px the falls) until the v5.3 block-out is data. Things moved to fit keep the brief's point as moved_from. The market is at the old bridges' west foot, where lane G's stop is and the roads and the canal arrive (the brief said east foot).
